title: Reginary 24 Pcs 20 x 20 Inches Cheese Cloths Bulk, Grade 100, Hemmed Cheesecloth for Straining Unbleached Cotton Muslin Cloth Reusable for Cooking Baking Juicing Cheese Making
description:
About this item
Plentiful Quantity for Usage: the package contains 24 pieces grade 100 hemmed cheesecloth, which are approx. 50 x 50 cm/ 20 x 20 inches, ample quantities and ideal sizes to meet most food straining needs, without cutting or shedding
Dependable Unbleached Cotton: the cotton muslin cloth is made of pure cotton, unbleached and natural, safe and reliable to use, which will not stain cheese, yogurt, turkey or other food
High Efficiency Filtration: the cheese cloths for straining are designed with 40 x 40 thread per inch weave, tight mesh to filter more impurities, efficient and suitable for most filtration needs
Functional and Practical: the muslin cloth for straining is made of only pure cotton, so you don't have to worry about fibers or other impurities in it; The rolled edges of the cotton are precisely sewn and the reliable seams will not burst
Versatile to Use: you can use the cotton cheesecloth for straining to make a variety of foods, such as wrapping homemade cheese and filtering milk, juice, jelly, brewed coffee, honey and beeswax; It can also be applied for canning, pressing, home decoration and more
